metrics.means: the built pocket cross-section is the shape the design calls for
the built pocket count equals the counted pan count
the built row count equals the read row count
the built column count equals the read column count
the deck land between pockets is uniform across the field
metrics.discriminating_power_note: passes because pitch_x - pitch_y happens to equal pan_width - pan_height in the current defaults. That is not enforced anywhere and would fail if either pitch moved.

metrics.means: the border land is no wider than the inter-pocket land is tight
metrics.discriminating_power_note: the tray envelope is now DEFINED as field + 2*land and the metric asks margin <= land, so equality holds by construction for every default build. It still fires against a supplied envelope — see test_a_loose_border_still_fails_the_margin_metric — but its pass is not evidence about the design.

metrics.means: pocket centres lie on an orthogonal lattice
the outer silhouette carries a real corner radius
metrics.discriminating_power_note: passes for any non-zero corner radius; it detects a hard-edged slab, nothing finer.

metrics.means: the tray height is small against its footprint
metrics.discriminating_power_note: 0.046 against a 0.15 threshold — passes with more than 3x headroom, so it would not catch a moderately thicker tray.

metrics.means: decorative ornament did NOT become moulded relief
metrics.discriminating_power_note: the tray kernel cannot express ornament as relief at all.

headline: 6/6 DISCRIMINATING metrics pass; 2 pass by construction, 1 with large headroom, 1 guaranteed by construction
weighted_score_caveat: the aggregate includes metrics that cannot fail for a default build. Read discriminating_metrics_passed, not this number.
why_no_pixel_overlay: the ES3083 sheet carries no calibrated scale, so an overlay would report a number with no unit behind it
does_not_measure: visual similarity to the source image
whether the intent itself is correct — it is an AI draft

provisional_default_changed_by_this_metr.found: the arbitrary 118.0 x 70.0 tray envelope gave a 3.8 mm border against a 1.181821 mm inter-pocket land, contradicting the intent's 'tight margins' reading
provisional_default_changed_by_this_metr.action: the tray envelope is now DERIVED as field + 2*land: 109.563642 x 64.763642 mm
provisional_default_changed_by_this_metr.what_was_NOT_changed: the metric threshold — a supplied loose envelope still fails MARGIN_REALISED
provisional_default_changed_by_this_metr.consequence_recorded_honestly: because the envelope is now defined as field + 2*land and the metric asks margin <= land, MARGIN_REALISED can no longer fail for a DEFAULT build. It is reclassified PASSES_BY_CONSTRUCTION and excluded from the discriminating count rather than left inflating it.
provisional_default_changed_by_this_metr.authority: the envelope remains a PROVISIONAL_DESIGN_DEFAULT with no authoritative source
